name: adb-install
description: Install an APK on a connected Android device or emulator via `adb install`. Set ANDROID_SERIAL in the environment to target a specific device when multiple are connected. Prefer gradle-install-debug for debug builds built from a Gradle project.

subcommand.name: install
subcommand.description: Install the given APK file onto the connected device.

positional_args.name: apk_path
positional_args.description: Path to the APK file to install.

options.name: r
options.description: Replace an existing application (keep data and cache).

options.name: t
options.description: Allow test APKs to be installed (required for APKs built with testOnly=true).

subcommand.install_instructions: Install ADB via Android Studio or: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.usage: Pass -r to reinstall over an existing installation while preserving app data.
custom.tip: For Gradle projects, prefer gradle-install-debug (handles the build step too).
